content: Confirmed via microsoft/vcpkg triplets on GitHub: x64-linux.cmake, arm64-linux.cmake, arm64-osx.cmake are built-in triplets with VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE=static (CRT/dylib linkage stays dynamic). x64-osx.cmake is static too but lives under triplets/community/ (still fully usable via --triplet). x64-windows-static-md.cmake (built-in) sets VCPKG_CRT_LINKAGE=dynamic, VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE=static -- static libs, dynamic (MD) CRT, matching PROJECT.md's plan exactly.
